attributes.law_screen: claim.law.IT_empty-bodied-if-elides-its-own-comparison.20260901.v1: SCREENED and DECISIVE AS A VETO -- the intuitive cure for target's `beq`+`b` pair here is `if (hit) {} else { var = 0; }`, and this law says MWCC's front end elides an empty-bodied if whole (comparison, operand loads and all). That probe was therefore NOT spent; the ternary was chosen instead precisely because a ternary's arm block is NOT elided. claim.law.float-clamp-ternary-diamond-vs-negated-guard.20260831.v1: APPLIED as the mechanism source -- its sentence 'MWCC collapses an empty statement block but never collapses a ternary's arm block' is the operative one, and its 'empty-arm b is exactly the target-only b such residuals show' matched our census signature exactly. ITS STATED SCOPE IS FLOAT AND IT RECORDS AN INTEGER NEGATIVE; that negative was screened and judged NOT to bind here because it concerned REMOVING a cror when negating a float compare, whereas this residual is the opposite direction (GAINING an empty-arm b on an integer compare whose negation is already free). Measured positive -- see the new law claim.law.IH_ternary-diamond-lever-extends-to-integer-guards.20260901.v1. claim.law.if-else-arm-swap-controls-fallthrough-placement.20260831.v1: APPLIED to axis 2; its precondition (both arms are genuine STATEMENT bodies, not a scalar ternary expression) is satisfied for eD/eC/eB, and its recorded ternary-expression negative is why eA -- whose target shape shows the empty-arm b -- was given the ternary form instead of an arm swap. claim.law.empty-block-branch-pair-splits-forward-vs-backedge.20260831.v1: SCREENED; all 24 sites are the FORWARD variant (the unconditional b targets the merge point ahead of it, never a loop backedge), i.e. the reproducible half, which is what licensed working the axis at all. claim.law.EN-ops-multiset-cannot-classify-a-residual-run-slotdiff-first.20260901.v1 and claim.law.fuzzy-can-underweight-a-real-improvement.20260830.v1: APPLIED to arbitrate axis 2's CONFLICT verdict (real regressed 939->947 while the multiset improved 97t->91t); fresh-report fuzzy was the arbiter and read 70.4288% -> 72.3306%, so the keep was banked with probe.py --rebase-best. claim.law.stack-slots-descend-in-declaration-order.20260831.v1 and claim.law.local-block-is-bottom-anchored-so-the-lowest-pad-is-the-shift-lever.20260831.v1: SCREENED for the residual frame gap, not yet exercised (see residual).
attributes.probed_form: AXIS 1 (kept), BTN_EDGE macro tail, replacing `if (!hit) { var = 0; }` with exactly: `var = hit ? var : 0;`  --  AXIS 2 (kept), direction nibbles, replacing the four zero-arm-first guards with exactly: `eD = lev8 >> 6; if (eD != 0 && (old8 & 0xC0) == 0) { eD = eD << 6; } else { eD = 0; }` / `eC = lev8 >> 4 & 3; if (eC != 0 && (old8 & 0x30) == 0) { eC = eC << 4; } else { eC = 0; }` / `eA = lev8 & 3; eA = (eA != 0 && (old8 & 3) == 0) ? eA : 0;` / `eB = lev8 >> 2 & 3; if (eB != 0 && (old8 & 0xC) == 0) { eB = eB << 2; } else { eB = 0; }`. Note eA is deliberately the TERNARY form (target @0x230-0x258 shows the empty-arm `b`) and reads lev8 rather than lev so all four nibbles share one source register, matching target's single r9.
attributes.residual: BASELINE fuzzy 70.0884%, real 949, insns T611/O574, multiset 137t, frame T192/O152. BEST fuzzy 72.3306%, real 947, insns T611/O626, multiset 91t, frame T192/O160. SIDE-DECOMPOSITION OF THE COUNT DELTA (the method the work order asked for, and it was the key to this function): the baseline count gap of 37 was NOT a 37-instruction shortfall but the residue of two much larger CANCELLING populations -- target-only totalled 87 tokens (+25 b +19 beq +13 lwz +9 stw +7 rlwinm +5 cmpwi +4 cmplwi +2 clrlwi +1 slwi +1 bgt +1 blt) against ours-only 50 (-19 addi -19 bne -6 rlwinm. -2 bge -2 clrlwi. -1 li -1 srwi.), and 57 of those 137 tokens (42%) were ONE repeating mechanism: 19-24 instances of target `cmpwi;beq;b;li var,0` against our `cmpwi;bne;li var,0`. Reading the count gap alone would have hidden it. REMAINING RESIDUAL, one named mechanism: EDGE-VALUE STACK RESIDENCY. slotdiff --all reports frame T192/O160 (32-byte deficit) with ten TARGET-ONLY slots -- 20, 84, 92, 96, 100, 104, 108, 112, 116, 120 -- each used 2-4 times. The aligned view at 0x2e4-0x2f8 shows the mechanism precisely: target materialises each edge value with a PLAIN `rlwinm r3,r10,0,22,22`, spills it (`stw r3,116(r1)`), then RELOADS it (`lwz r3,116(r1)`) and tests it with a separate `cmplwi r3,0`; ours fuses value and test into the record form `rlwinm. r3,r8,0,22,22` and keeps the value in a register, paying a copy (`addi r9,r3,0`) instead. That is the whole of the current ours-only -23 addi -15 mr (38 copies) and target-only +11 lwz +8 stw +6 rlwinm +4 cmpwi +3 cmplwi. NEXT AGENT: this is a register-PRESSURE/spill-residency question, not a guard-shape one -- the 24 edge locals plus the final 28-term OR expression are what set the pressure. Do NOT re-probe the guard polarity (closed, twice, positively) or the empty-bodied-if form (vetoed by the IT law). The untried idea worth one probe is whether the original declared the edge values as an ARRAY rather than 24 separate scalars, which would force stack residency by construction; the slot evidence (ten slots, 2-4 uses each, non-contiguous) is suggestive but does NOT confirm a contiguous array, so treat it as a hypothesis to measure, not a finding.
